source_text.body:
Build profit/loss statements for rental properties
Meta Muse logged into property software and built profit/loss statements for every rental property.
Done with
MM
Meta Muse
What they did
Meta Muse received login access to the user's property management software. The agent logged in on its own and generated a profit/loss statement for each rental property.
How it went
It completed the statements for every rental. No further results or shortfalls are stated.
Try it yourself
with
Meta Muse
Copy prompt
Log into my property management software at [software name] and build a profit and loss statement for each of my rental properties for [time period]. Put them in a spreadsheet with one tab per property, showing income, expenses by category, and net profit. Stop when every property has a tab, and flag any numbers that look missing or odd. Don't change or delete anything in the software.
